maya: Quick ordering affordance audit for the routing editor — posting a handful of small UX fixes. Screenshot attached. jordan: Thanks. tl;dr: make priority numbers sticky, de-emphasize noisy visuals, surface tie-breaker info, and rethink where simulation controls live. sam: Copy first: stop using alarm words. Replace 'Invalid rule' -> 'Conflicting rule' and if it's non-blocking show 'Resolve conflict' rather than 'Fix now'. taylor: Simulator placement: move 'Run' into the preview header. Users look there first. Add a tiny live vs single-shot toggle. lee: Accessibility: drag handles are low contrast (~2.2:1). Need >=4.5:1. Also keyboard reorder missing. Pattern: Space to pick, arrows to move, Space to drop + `aria-describedby` with instructions. maya: @lee paste a minimal CSS suggestion? lee: Sure: ` .drag-handle{ color:#4f5659 } .drag-handle:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset:2px } ` harper: UI detail: long condition strings currently truncate with ellipses. Consider vertical wrapping with subtle fade or tooltip on hover so users can scan without opening each rule. jordan: For equal-priority rules show a small clock icon that reveals creation timestamp or rule-id on hover. Make it optional in advanced view. sam: For preview updates, add `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the preview list container so SR users hear the simulation result. Example: `
...
`. taylor: Also propose two density modes: compact (default for >8 rules) and roomy (default for <=8). Toggle in toolbar so users can switch. maya: I'll mock: sticky priority col, compact vs roomy rows, drag contrast states, relocated simulator, and tie-breaker tooltip. ETA: Wednesday afternoon. jordan: Small microinteraction: when a rule is picked up for reorder visually lift it and add `aria-grabbed=\"true\"`. When dropped, focus the moved rule. lee: Accessibility checklist I'll add to the ticket: contrast numbers, keyboard reorder flow, focus management, `aria-live` on preview, announce reorder completion. harper: Copy tweaks doc: I'll add suggested language examples and examples for conflict vs error states. ops-bot: Note: linked design PR #1213 and created ticket A11Y-278 for keyboard reorder. maya: Thanks — will drop mocks + a small HTML demo. Please review focus states and copy in the next 24h. jordan: Schedule a 15-min pick-up tomorrow after mocks land. :calendar: :thumbsup:
